first_hit_gate.rule: T2: only the first surface the camera ray hits shades as the hologram; anything behind it is passed through as transparent. Back faces are culled.
first_hit_gate.runtime_implementation: viewer FirstHitRenderPass: pass 1 writes depth only for real hologram surfaces (Orig Alpha > 0.5, in front of the ear plane, front-facing; features, corneas, teeth and mouth interior excluded); pass 2 shades with depthWrite off and LessEqual against it, so only the nearest surface blends over the ground. Features (Feature = 1) draw after, depth-tested, with a polygon offset.

bloom.recipe: screened bloom as look04: gaussian blur at width/120, scaled 0.35, screened back over the render
bloom.runtime_implementation: viewer ScreenBloomPass after OutputPass (display space, as the PIL composite): separable Gaussian with sigma = buffer width / 120 in a buffer capped at 640 px wide, x 0.35, screened. Replaces UnrealBloomPass.

shader.alpha_fresnel: look01: a1 = a0 + (1 - a0) * fresnel * 0.85, independent of Alpha Mult

fix1.root_cause: object-linked material slots: look01 writes the HOLO copy into the OBJECT slot, new_from_object copies the MESH DATA list
fix1.cull_is_authoritative: Cull 0 means the material renders both sides (look04 fix for the mirrored, un-flipped card normals). The viewer must map it to THREE.DoubleSide; FrontSide culls the avatar-left brow and liner.

smile_rule.rule: never the wide joy smile on the hologram; closed / smirk / slightly open only
smile_rule.enforcement: the caps are baked into the exported morph maxima: a morph at 1.0 IS the capped maximum, so a runtime cannot exceed them by driving a morph harder
smile_rule.measured_result: look06: max mouth opening across the clip fell from 30 x 96 px at frame 676 to 12 x 73 px at frame 658, at 640
smile_rule.candidate_skin_caps_note: NX18_Smile_Joy and NX18_Smile_Lower_Lids stay in the clamp06 cap tables because clamp06.py caps them on the candidate skin (source evidence). They have no runtime morph; see excluded.manifest_only_morphs.

motion.source: Cameron 2026-09-22 23:30 CDT: less body movement, head and neck must move

states.idle: head and neck idle yaw/pitch, slight spine sway, blink on the 3-7 s timer, mouth closed
states.listening: idle plus a small forward head pitch and a slower, wider idle yaw (attentive)
states.thinking: idle with the head held slightly off-axis and blink interval shortened
states.speaking: Jaw and Press driven from the TTS audio analyser, speech nod on the head, idle sway continues, smile caps enforced
states.dissolve_out: raise Fade Z0 and Z1 together until the figure is gone, then hide

bake_check.problem: the rendered face takes its smile-region positions from render-hidden candidate skins through four Geometry-Nodes Strict Regions modifiers; glTF cannot carry that
bake_check.method: every exported state is evaluated through the whole modifier stack and written as a plain shape key on a flat copy

unbaked_shrinkwrap_tail.cause: two Shrinkwrap modifiers whose projection fails on a closed lid, throwing a tail of vertices 170-230 mm across the head. Measured in logs/diag_blink.json as the ASSET's behaviour, not this bake's: the same tail appears when the whole frame 651 is evaluated. Cycles hides it because the liner is a thin line.
unbaked_shrinkwrap_tail.handling: any morph delta past 30.0 mm is written as zero, leaving that vertex at its neutral position

known_deviation.accepted_by: main NOX, NOX-11771 review round 1 (2026-09-24), finding 5 nit, accepted for v1, no rebuild
known_deviation.cause: NX8_Upper_Lid_Line shrinkwrap tail (unbaked verts) plus Strict Regions residue; RESULTS.md contradictions 1-5

press_choice.rule: argmin clamp06.scan_gap over 310-647 step 8, ties broken by max NX6_Speech_Lip_Cover
press_choice.caveat: scan_gap reads 9 px at the closed-mouth reference frame 1, so it is relative, not absolute (look06 RESULTS: the in-Blender ray scan has chin/neck notch false positives)
